about.title: About RecallVET
about.subtitle: We're building the future of veterinary medicine in Africa
about.mission_text: RecallVET was born from a simple observation: African veterinary professionals deserve digital tools that match their expertise. Our mission is to provide a complete, affordable platform adapted to African realities to digitize and professionalize veterinary practice across the continent.
about.vision_text: To be the reference platform for animal health in Africa by 2030, covering 50 countries and contributing to improved food security and animal welfare.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions from our users

questions.question: How much does RecallVET cost?
questions.answer: RecallVET offers 3 plans starting from 15,000 XAF/month. All include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

questions.question: Does RecallVET work offline?
questions.answer: RecallVET is a cloud application. You need an internet connection. However, we are working on an offline mode for the mobile version.

questions.question: Can I import my existing data?
questions.answer: Yes! RecallVET supports CSV import of your clients, animals and products. Our team assists you for a stress-free migration.

questions.question: Is RecallVET suitable for farms?
questions.answer: Absolutely. The Farm module manages farms, herds, health visits and health events. Ideal for rural veterinarians.

questions.question: How does customer support work?
questions.answer: Email and chat support Monday to Friday. Pro and Enterprise clients receive priority support with a guaranteed 2-hour response time.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Yes. SSL encryption, secure hosting, daily backups and compliance with data protection standards.

timeline.title: The idea
timeline.desc: A Cameroonian vet frustrated by paper records shared his experience with a developer. The idea for RecallVET was born.

timeline.title: The prototype
timeline.desc: First version of the clinic module tested in 3 veterinary practices in Yaounde. 94% satisfaction.

timeline.title: Beta launch
timeline.desc: Beta opened to 50 clinics in 5 countries (Cameroon, Senegal, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Nigeria).

timeline.title: Version 1.0
timeline.desc: Official launch with all 3 complete modules. 150 active clinics in the first month.

timeline.title: Expansion
timeline.desc: 500+ clinics, 15 countries, new funding round to accelerate mobile development.

timeline.title: Version 2.0
timeline.desc: Artificial intelligence, offline mobile app, partner lab integration and public API.
